classifications.title: Murder
classifications.punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine (as prescribed under Section 103)

classifications.title: Punishment for murder
classifications.punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine

classifications.title: Culpable homicide
classifications.punishment: Punishable under Section 105

classifications.title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine

classifications.title: Causing death by negligence
classifications.punishment: BNS 106(1): Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine. BNS 106(2) [Hit & Run]: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.

classifications.title: Attempt to murder
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; if hurt caused, life imprisonment or up to 10 years

classifications.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹10,000, or both

classifications.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

classifications.title: Act endangering life or personal safety of others
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to ₹2,500, or both; if hurt caused up to 6 months

classifications.title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both

classifications.title: Theft
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both. Community service for petty theft under ₹5,000

classifications.title: Theft in dwelling house, or means of transport or place of worship, etc.
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

classifications.title: Extortion
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years, or fine, or both

classifications.title: Robbery
classifications.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; on highway between sunset and sunrise up to 14 years

classifications.title: Dacoity
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine

classifications.title: Criminal breach of trust
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both

classifications.title: Cheating
classifications.punishment: BNS 318(2): Up to 3 years. BNS 318(4) [mirror of IPC 420]: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

classifications.title: Criminal intimidation
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both; if threat to cause death, up to 7 years

classifications.title: Punishment for rape
classifications.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 10 years extending to life, and fine

classifications.title: Punishment for rape in certain cases (Rape of child)
classifications.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 20 years extending to life, or death

classifications.title: Gang rape
classifications.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 20 years extending to life; death for minor girl

classifications.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment not less than 1 year extending to 5 years, and fine

classifications.title: Stalking
classifications.punishment: 1st Conviction: Up to 3 years and fine (Bailable). Subsequent: Up to 5 years and fine (Non-Bailable)

classifications.title: Dowry death
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment not less than 7 years extending to life imprisonment

classifications.title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

classifications.title: Kidnapping
classifications.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

classifications.title: Driving by a drunken person or by a person under the influence of drugs
classifications.classification_source: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (Section 202 Police Arrest Power)
classifications.punishment: 1st Offence: Up to 6 months imprisonment or fine up to ₹10,000, or both. Repeat Offence: Up to 2 years or fine up to ₹15,000, or both
